profile.name: Pravesh Bahadur Shahi
profile.title: Bsc.IT student | Mobile Application Developer
profile.summary: I am a Bsc.IT student and a mobile application developer with practical experience building mobile applications and software projects. I work with React Native, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, and MySQL to develop user-focused applications, connect mobile interfaces with backend APIs, and manage application data. I also have experience with Python, Java, web technologies, databases, and interactive 3D development. I enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into practical software.
